package meter

// Independent adversarial review r33 unit proofs for agent-core follow-up 53
// (commit b094ffac72f2f4f247a3e2b592a6659a84f1d51a at review base
// 29cd267162fa614c444122865b62f405e2f58802).
// TEST ONLY deterministic clocks, in-memory counter sources, and temp SQLite.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/node/enforce"
	"github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/node/internal/usagestore"
	"github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/pkg/api"
)

// TestR33_Q1_ClockDomainAndFidelity proves the exact clock-domain behavior of
// Sample, CheckpointForRestart, and FinalSample across:
//   - now == head.LastSample (unchanged readings)
//   - 0 < head.LastSample.Sub(now) < interval (unchanged readings)
//   - exact boundary head.LastSample.Sub(now) == interval (unchanged readings)
//   - just past boundary: interval + 1ns and interval + 1µs (planClockGap)
//   - forward time now.After(head.LastSample) (unchanged readings)
//   - sub-microsecond timestamps within the same microsecond as head.LastSample
//   - head.LastSample.IsZero() with an open epoch
func TestR33_Q1_ClockDomainAndFidelity(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	seedOpenMeter := func(t *testing.T) (*Meter, *usagestore.Store, *fakeSrc, *clock, usagestore.Head) {
		t.Helper()
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		// Start with zero counters at t0 so initial baseline opens without an
		// uncheckpointed-bytes startup gap.
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q1", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q1", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 5096, upP: 5, dnB: 9192, dnP: 9,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("forward Sample: %v", err)
		}
		h, err := s.Head(t.Context())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Head: %v", err)
		}
		if h.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || !h.LastSample.Equal(t0.Add(10*time.Second)) || h.NextSeq != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected seeded head: %+v", h)
		}
		return m, s, src, clk, h
	}

	// 1. Unchanged readings at now == LastSample, 0 < rollback < interval (5s),
	// and exact boundary rollback == interval (10s).
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name     string
		rollback time.Duration
	}{
		{name: "equal_timestamp", rollback: 0},
		{name: "bounded_rollback_5s", rollback: 5 * time.Second},
		{name: "exact_interval_boundary_10s", rollback: 10 * time.Second},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			// (a) Ordinary Sample returns ErrHold and performs no store commit.
			mS, sS, _, clkS, hBefore := seedOpenMeter(t)
			clkS.Set(hBefore.LastSample.Add(-tc.rollback))
			if err := mS.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
				t.Fatalf("Sample at rollback=%s: got %v, want ErrHold", tc.rollback, err)
			}
			hAfterS, err := sS.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(hAfterS, hBefore) {
				t.Fatalf("Sample ErrHold mutated head: got %+v, want %+v", hAfterS, hBefore)
			}

			// (b) CheckpointForRestart returns nil, keeps OpenEpoch open, preserves
			// LastSample (never moves it backward), and emits no event.
			mR, sR, _, clkR, hBeforeR := seedOpenMeter(t)
			clkR.Set(hBeforeR.LastSample.Add(-tc.rollback))
			if err := mR.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart at rollback=%s: got %v, want nil", tc.rollback, err)
			}
			hAfterR, err := sR.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if hAfterR.OpenEpoch != hBeforeR.OpenEpoch {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart changed OpenEpoch: got %s, want %s", hAfterR.OpenEpoch, hBeforeR.OpenEpoch)
			}
			if !hAfterR.LastSample.Equal(hBeforeR.LastSample) {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart changed LastSample: got %s, want %s", hAfterR.LastSample, hBeforeR.LastSample)
			}
			if hAfterR.NextSeq != hBeforeR.NextSeq {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart emitted unexpected event: NextSeq=%d, want %d", hAfterR.NextSeq, hBeforeR.NextSeq)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(hAfterR.Counters, hBeforeR.Counters) {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart mutated Counters: got %+v, want %+v", hAfterR.Counters, hBeforeR.Counters)
			}

			// (c) FinalSample returns nil, closes the epoch with "final_sample",
			// preserves LastSample, and emits no event.
			mF, sF, _, clkF, hBeforeF := seedOpenMeter(t)
			clkF.Set(hBeforeF.LastSample.Add(-tc.rollback))
			if err := mF.FinalSample(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("FinalSample at rollback=%s: got %v, want nil", tc.rollback, err)
			}
			hAfterF, err := sF.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if hAfterF.OpenEpoch != uuid.Nil || hAfterF.LastCloseReason != "final_sample" {
				t.Fatalf("FinalSample did not close epoch: OpenEpoch=%s LastCloseReason=%q", hAfterF.OpenEpoch, hAfterF.LastCloseReason)
			}
			if !hAfterF.LastSample.Equal(hBeforeF.LastSample) {
				t.Fatalf("FinalSample changed LastSample: got %s, want %s", hAfterF.LastSample, hBeforeF.LastSample)
			}
			if hAfterF.NextSeq != hBeforeF.NextSeq {
				t.Fatalf("FinalSample emitted unexpected event: NextSeq=%d, want %d", hAfterF.NextSeq, hBeforeF.NextSeq)
			}
		})
	}

	// 2. Just past the 10s interval boundary (10s+1ns and 10s+1µs): all three
	// methods must take planClockGap (emitting a clock_anomaly gap of 1µs width
	// anchored at [head.LastSample, head.LastSample+1µs)).
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name     string
		rollback time.Duration
	}{
		{name: "over_interval_by_1ns", rollback: 10*time.Second + time.Nanosecond},
		{name: "over_interval_by_1us", rollback: 10*time.Second + time.Microsecond},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			for _, mode := range []string{"sample", "restart", "final"} {
				t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
					m, s, _, clk, hBefore := seedOpenMeter(t)
					now := hBefore.LastSample.Add(-tc.rollback)
					clk.Set(now)
					var err error
					switch mode {
					case "sample":
						err = m.Sample(t.Context())
					case "restart":
						err = m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context())
					case "final":
						err = m.FinalSample(t.Context())
					}
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatalf("%s at rollback=%s: %v", mode, tc.rollback, err)
					}
					hAfter, err := s.Head(t.Context())
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if hAfter.NextSeq != hBefore.NextSeq+1 {
						t.Fatalf("%s did not emit clock_anomaly event: NextSeq=%d, want %d", mode, hAfter.NextSeq, hBefore.NextSeq+1)
					}
					ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, hBefore.NextSeq)
					if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityGap || ev.Gap == nil || ev.Gap.Reason != api.UsageGapReasonClockAnomaly {
						t.Fatalf("%s event: quality=%s gap=%+v, want clock_anomaly gap", mode, ev.Quality, ev.Gap)
					}
					wantStart := hBefore.LastSample
					wantEnd := wantStart.Add(time.Microsecond)
					if !ev.IntervalStart.Equal(wantStart) || !ev.IntervalEnd.Equal(wantEnd) {
						t.Fatalf("%s clock_anomaly interval=[%s, %s), want [%s, %s)",
							mode, ev.IntervalStart, ev.IntervalEnd, wantStart, wantEnd)
					}
					if mode == "final" {
						if hAfter.OpenEpoch != uuid.Nil || hAfter.LastCloseReason != "final_sample" {
							t.Fatalf("FinalSample after clock_anomaly left OpenEpoch=%s LastCloseReason=%q", hAfter.OpenEpoch, hAfter.LastCloseReason)
						}
					} else {
						if hAfter.OpenEpoch != hBefore.OpenEpoch || !hAfter.LastSample.Equal(wantEnd) {
							t.Fatalf("%s after clock_anomaly: OpenEpoch=%s (want %s) LastSample=%s (want %s)",
								mode, hAfter.OpenEpoch, hBefore.OpenEpoch, hAfter.LastSample, wantEnd)
						}
					}
				})
			}
		})
	}

	// 3. Forward time now.After(head.LastSample) with unchanged readings:
	// Sample and CheckpointForRestart behave identically (advance LastSample,
	// keep OpenEpoch, emit no event).
	t.Run("forward_time_unchanged_readings", func(t *testing.T) {
		mS, sS, _, clkS, hBeforeS := seedOpenMeter(t)
		mR, sR, _, clkR, hBeforeR := seedOpenMeter(t)
		nextT := hBeforeS.LastSample.Add(10 * time.Second)
		clkS.Set(nextT)
		clkR.Set(nextT)
		if err := mS.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Sample forward: %v", err)
		}
		if err := mR.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart forward: %v", err)
		}
		hS, _ := sS.Head(t.Context())
		hR, _ := sR.Head(t.Context())
		if !hS.LastSample.Equal(nextT) || !hR.LastSample.Equal(nextT) || hS.NextSeq != hBeforeS.NextSeq || hR.NextSeq != hBeforeR.NextSeq || hS.OpenEpoch != hBeforeS.OpenEpoch || hR.OpenEpoch != hBeforeR.OpenEpoch {
			t.Fatalf("forward unchanged mismatch: Sample=%+v Restart=%+v", hS, hR)
		}
	})

	// 4. Sub-microsecond input within the same microsecond as LastSample:
	// Because LastSample is stored at microsecond precision (T1 = t0+10s), a call
	// at T1+331ns has now.After(LastSample) == true, so eventInterval advances
	// SampledAt to T1+1µs. A subsequent call at T1+800ns then sees
	// !now.After(LastSample) (LastSample == T1+1µs), where Sample returns ErrHold
	// and CheckpointForRestart returns nil preserving LastSample == T1+1µs.
	t.Run("sub_microsecond_same_microsecond_as_last_sample", func(t *testing.T) {
		m, s, _, clk, hBefore := seedOpenMeter(t)
		subNow := hBefore.LastSample.Add(331 * time.Nanosecond)
		clk.Set(subNow)
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("first sub-microsecond Sample: %v", err)
		}
		hMid, err := s.Head(t.Context())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		wantAdvanced := hBefore.LastSample.Add(time.Microsecond)
		if !hMid.LastSample.Equal(wantAdvanced) {
			t.Fatalf("sub-microsecond forward Sample set LastSample=%s, want %s", hMid.LastSample, wantAdvanced)
		}
		// Now at T1+800ns (< T1+1µs), now.After(LastSample) is false.
		clk.Set(hBefore.LastSample.Add(800 * time.Nanosecond))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
			t.Fatalf("second sub-microsecond Sample: got %v, want ErrHold", err)
		}
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("second sub-microsecond CheckpointForRestart: got %v, want nil", err)
		}
		hFinal, err := s.Head(t.Context())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !hFinal.LastSample.Equal(wantAdvanced) || hFinal.OpenEpoch != hBefore.OpenEpoch {
			t.Fatalf("sub-microsecond CheckpointForRestart head: %+v", hFinal)
		}
	})

	// 5. Open epoch with head.LastSample.IsZero(): !head.LastSample.IsZero() is
	// false at delta.go:264, so Sample and CheckpointForRestart behave identically
	// after clearing meta.last_sample via direct SQLite setup.
	t.Run("open_epoch_with_zero_last_sample", func(t *testing.T) {
		clearLastSample := func(t *testing.T, st *usagestore.Store) {
			t.Helper()
			rawDB, err := sql.Open("sqlite", st.Path())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer rawDB.Close()
			if _, err := rawDB.Exec(`UPDATE meta SET last_sample = NULL WHERE id = 1`); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		mS, sS, _, _, _ := seedOpenMeter(t)
		mR, sR, _, _, _ := seedOpenMeter(t)
		clearLastSample(t, sS)
		clearLastSample(t, sR)
		if err := mS.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Sample with zero LastSample: %v", err)
		}
		if err := mR.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with zero LastSample: %v", err)
		}
		hS, _ := sS.Head(t.Context())
		hR, _ := sR.Head(t.Context())
		if hS.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || hR.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || !hS.LastSample.Equal(hR.LastSample) || hS.NextSeq != hR.NextSeq || !reflect.DeepEqual(hS.Counters, hR.Counters) {
			t.Fatalf("zero LastSample heads differ: sample=%+v restart=%+v", hS, hR)
		}
	})
}

// TestR33_Q2_DurableCheckpointAndExactOnce proves that an accepted unchanged
// CheckpointForRestart at now <= LastSample commits a real SQLite transaction
// (invoking StepCheckpoint, StepBeforeCommit, StepAfterCommit and skipping
// StepInsert), preserves all durable Head fields, ACK watermark, sealed outbox
// and archived events, ReadSnapshot, and OutboxStatus across close/reopen, is
// idempotent across repeated calls, and counts the next forward delta once.
func TestR33_Q2_DurableCheckpointAndExactOnce(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 13, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	clk := &clock{t: t0}

	const largeBase uint64 = (1 << 53) + 1 // 9007199254740993
	src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q2",
		reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1},
		reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2},
	)}

	var steps []string
	recordHooks := false
	dbPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "usage.db")
	opt := usagestore.Options{
		Now: clk.Now,
		Hook: func(step string) error {
			if recordHooks {
				steps = append(steps, step)
			}
			return nil
		},
	}
	s, err := usagestore.Open(dbPath, nodeID, incID, opt)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = s.Close() }()

	// New opens the initial zero baseline epoch at t0.
	m, err := New(Config{
		NodeID: nodeID, IncarnationID: incID, Store: s, Source: src,
		Interval: 10 * time.Second, Now: clk.Now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer m.Close()

	// Sample 1 at t0+10s: large >2^53 delta on devA upload, normal delta on devB.
	clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
	src.set(observe("boot-q2",
		reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: largeBase, upP: 10, dnB: 2000, dnP: 2},
		reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 3000, upP: 3, dnB: 4096, dnP: 8},
	))
	if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("sample 1: %v", err)
	}

	// ACK seq 1 so the store has both archived ACKed history and an active outbox.
	if err := s.ApplyACK(t.Context(), usagestore.BatchACK{
		Highest: 1,
		Results: []usagestore.EventResult{{Seq: 1, Status: usagestore.StatusAccepted}},
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyACK(1): %v", err)
	}

	// Sample 2 at t0+20s: creates unacked seq 2 in outbox.
	clk.Set(t0.Add(20 * time.Second))
	src.set(observe("boot-q2",
		reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: largeBase + 1000, upP: 12, dnB: 2500, dnP: 3},
		reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 3000, upP: 3, dnB: 4096 + 2048, dnP: 10},
	))
	if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("sample 2: %v", err)
	}

	headBefore, err := s.Head(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ev1Before, err := s.Event(t.Context(), 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ev2Before, err := s.Event(t.Context(), 2)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapBefore, err := usagestore.ReadSnapshot(t.Context(), dbPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	statusBefore, err := s.OutboxStatus(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Call 1: CheckpointForRestart at now == LastSample (t0+20s).
	steps = nil
	recordHooks = true
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart at equal timestamp: %v", err)
	}
	recordHooks = false
	wantSteps := []string{
		StepRead,
		StepPlan,
		usagestore.StepCheckpoint,
		usagestore.StepBeforeCommit,
		usagestore.StepAfterCommit,
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(steps, wantSteps) {
		t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart steps=%v, want %v (must commit SQLite without StepInsert)", steps, wantSteps)
	}

	// Call 2: Repeated CheckpointForRestart at a 5s rollback (t0+15s) to prove idempotence.
	clk.Set(t0.Add(15 * time.Second))
	steps = nil
	recordHooks = true
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart at 5s rollback: %v", err)
	}
	recordHooks = false
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(steps, wantSteps) {
		t.Fatalf("second CheckpointForRestart steps=%v, want %v", steps, wantSteps)
	}

	// Resume sampling after the restart barrier so subsequent Sample calls can proceed.
	m.ResumeSampling()

	// Verify durable state before close/reopen.
	checkDurableState := func(t *testing.T, st *usagestore.Store) {
		t.Helper()
		h, err := st.Head(t.Context())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(h, headBefore) {
			t.Fatalf("Head changed across unchanged CheckpointForRestart:\ngot:  %+v\nwant: %+v", h, headBefore)
		}
		ev1, err := st.Event(t.Context(), 1)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ev2, err := st.Event(t.Context(), 2)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(ev1.Payload, ev1Before.Payload) || ev1.Hash != ev1Before.Hash || ev1.State != "archived" {
			t.Fatalf("archived event 1 mutated: got hash=%s state=%s, want hash=%s state=archived", ev1.Hash, ev1.State, ev1Before.Hash)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(ev2.Payload, ev2Before.Payload) || ev2.Hash != ev2Before.Hash || ev2.State != "outbox" {
			t.Fatalf("outbox event 2 mutated: got hash=%s state=%s, want hash=%s state=outbox", ev2.Hash, ev2.State, ev2Before.Hash)
		}
		snap, err := usagestore.ReadSnapshot(t.Context(), dbPath)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(snap, snapBefore) {
			t.Fatalf("ReadSnapshot mutated:\ngot:  %+v\nwant: %+v", snap, snapBefore)
		}
		status, err := st.OutboxStatus(t.Context())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if status.UnackedEventCount != statusBefore.UnackedEventCount || status.UnackedPayloadBytes != statusBefore.UnackedPayloadBytes || status.CentralAckedThrough != statusBefore.CentralAckedThrough {
			t.Fatalf("OutboxStatus mutated: got %+v, want %+v", status, statusBefore)
		}
	}
	checkDurableState(t, s)

	// Close Meter and Store, reopen Store from disk, and verify persistence.
	m.Close()
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s2, err := usagestore.Open(dbPath, nodeID, incID, usagestore.Options{Now: clk.Now})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = s2.Close() }()
	checkDurableState(t, s2)

	// Start successor Meter on reopened Store (at t0+20s) and run a forward Sample at t0+30s.
	clk.Set(t0.Add(20 * time.Second))
	m2, err := New(Config{
		NodeID: nodeID, IncarnationID: incID, Store: s2, Source: src,
		Interval: 10 * time.Second, Now: clk.Now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer m2.Close()

	clk.Set(t0.Add(30 * time.Second))
	src.set(observe("boot-q2",
		reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: largeBase + 1000 + 500, upP: 13, dnB: 2500, dnP: 3},
		reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 3000, upP: 3, dnB: 4096 + 2048, dnP: 10},
	))
	if err := m2.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("successor forward Sample: %v", err)
	}
	ev3 := decodeStoredEvent(t, s2, 3)
	if ev3.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || ev3.MeterEpochId != headBefore.OpenEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("seq 3 quality=%s epoch=%s, want complete in %s", ev3.Quality, ev3.MeterEpochId, headBefore.OpenEpoch)
	}
	if !ev3.IntervalStart.Equal(t0.Add(20*time.Second)) || !ev3.IntervalEnd.Equal(t0.Add(30*time.Second)) {
		t.Fatalf("seq 3 interval=[%s, %s), want [%s, %s)",
			ev3.IntervalStart, ev3.IntervalEnd, t0.Add(20*time.Second), t0.Add(30*time.Second))
	}
	if len(ev3.Records) != 1 || ev3.Records[0].MemberId != memA || ev3.Records[0].DeviceId != devA || ev3.Records[0].BindingRevision.String() != "1" || uint64(ev3.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 500 || uint64(ev3.Records[0].DownloadBytes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("seq 3 records=%+v, want single exact-once +500 up record for devA", ev3.Records)
	}
}

// TestR33_Q3_ChangedReadingsAndAttribution proves how CheckpointForRestart at
// now <= LastSample behaves when counter readings or bindings change:
//   - Changed Bytes (including > 2^53) -> ErrHold, next forward sample counts delta once.
//   - Changed Packets alone -> ErrHold.
//   - Counter added (zero or non-zero) -> ErrHold.
//   - Counter removed -> DetectResets runs planSwitch (counter_discontinuity) before the rollback branch.
//   - Unchanged counter numbers with changed bindings, conflicting duplicate bindings, or an
//     initially unbound baseline -> CheckpointForRestart succeeds and retains head.Counters
//     attribution; next forward positive delta either attributes cleanly (when bindings match
//     or prior head had uuid.Nil) or emits a mapping-conflict gap.
func TestR33_Q3_ChangedReadingsAndAttribution(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 14, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	t.Run("bytes_changed_above_2pow53_returns_errhold_and_preserves_delta", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		const base uint64 = (1 << 53) + 10 // 9007199254741002
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: base, upP: 10, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		// Advance upload bytes by +1 at now == t0+10s and at now == t0+5s.
		src.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: base + 1, upP: 10, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with +1 byte at equal time: got %v, want ErrHold", err)
		}
		clk.Set(t0.Add(5 * time.Second))
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with +1 byte at 5s rollback: got %v, want ErrHold", err)
		}
		m.ResumeSampling()
		clk.Set(t0.Add(20 * time.Second))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("forward Sample after ErrHold: %v", err)
		}
		ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 2)
		if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || len(ev.Records) != 1 || uint64(ev.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("forward Sample event after ErrHold: %+v", ev)
		}
	})

	t.Run("packets_changed_bytes_unchanged_returns_errhold", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 4096, upP: 4, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Packets increase from 4 to 5 while Bytes remains 4096.
		src.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 4096, upP: 5, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with +1 packet: got %v, want ErrHold", err)
		}
		h, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		if h.Counters[1].Packets != 4 {
			t.Fatalf("ErrHold modified stored packets: %+v", h.Counters)
		}
	})

	t.Run("counter_added_zero_or_nonzero_returns_errhold", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, newBytes := range []uint64{0, 1024} {
			clk := &clock{t: t0}
			src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q3", reading{
				dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
			})}
			m, _ := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
			src.set(observe("boot-q3",
				reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1},
				reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: newBytes, upP: 1, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
			))
			clk.Set(t0.Add(-2 * time.Second))
			if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with added counter (bytes=%d): got %v, want ErrHold", newBytes, err)
			}
		}
	})

	t.Run("counter_removed_or_renamed_triggers_reset_switch", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q3",
			reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1},
			reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2},
		)}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		h0, _ := s.Head(t.Context())

		// Remove devB while rolling clock back 3s: DetectResets fires before the
		// now <= LastSample check and switches epochs with counter_discontinuity.
		clk.Set(t0.Add(-3 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q3",
			reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1},
		))
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart on removed counter: %v", err)
		}
		h1, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		if h1.OpenEpoch == h0.OpenEpoch || h1.OpenReason != string(api.UsageGapReasonCounterDiscontinuity) || h1.NextSeq != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("removed counter did not switch epoch: %+v", h1)
		}
		ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 1)
		if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityGap || ev.Gap == nil || ev.Gap.Reason != api.UsageGapReasonCounterDiscontinuity {
			t.Fatalf("removed counter event: %+v", ev)
		}
	})

	t.Run("unchanged_counters_with_changed_missing_or_conflicting_bindings", func(t *testing.T) {
		// Subcase 1: Bindings change from (memA, rev 1) to (memB, rev 2) while
		// counter numbers stay unchanged at now <= LastSample.
		// CheckpointForRestart succeeds and keeps head.Counters's (memA, rev 1);
		// a subsequent forward positive delta under (memB, rev 2) emits a
		// mapping_conflict gap because the epoch's stored baseline had (memA, rev 1).
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		clk.Set(t0.Add(-2 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memB, rev: 2,
		}))
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with changed binding and equal counters: %v", err)
		}
		hAfter, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		for _, c := range hAfter.Counters {
			if c.MemberID != memA || c.BindingRevision != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("expected head.Counters to preserve (memA, rev 1), got %+v", c)
			}
		}
		m.ResumeSampling()
		clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 1000, upP: 5, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 1)
		if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityGap || ev.Gap == nil || ev.Gap.Reason != api.UsageGapReasonUnknown {
			t.Fatalf("expected mapping conflict gap on mid-epoch binding change, got %+v", ev)
		}

		// Subcase 2: Conflicting duplicate bindings in obs.Bindings at
		// now <= LastSample with equal counters do not clobber stored (memA, rev 1).
		clk2 := &clock{t: t0}
		src2 := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m2, s2 := start(t, src2, clk2, usagestore.Options{})
		// Conflicting duplicate bindings for devA at now == t0 - 1s with equal counters.
		clk2.Set(t0.Add(-time.Second))
		obsConflict := observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})
		obsConflict.Bindings = append(obsConflict.Bindings, enforce.Binding{
			MemberID: memB, DeviceID: devA, BindingRevision: 2,
		})
		src2.set(obsConflict)
		if err := m2.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with conflicting bindings and equal counters: %v", err)
		}
		m2.ResumeSampling()
		// When the next forward sample has the clean (memA, rev 1) binding and +1024 B,
		// it attributes cleanly because head.Counters preserved (memA, rev 1).
		clk2.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src2.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 1024, upP: 5, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m2.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ev2 := decodeStoredEvent(t, s2, 1)
		if ev2.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || len(ev2.Records) != 1 || ev2.Records[0].MemberId != memA || uint64(ev2.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 1024 {
			t.Fatalf("expected clean attribution after preserved head.Counters, got %+v", ev2)
		}

		// Subcase 3: Initial baseline opened with nil bindings (uuid.Nil, 0) as in
		// PrepareSampling; CheckpointForRestart runs at now == t0 with populated
		// bindings and equal zero counters, followed by a forward positive delta.
		clk3 := &clock{t: t0}
		obsUnbound := observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: uuid.Nil, rev: 0, upB: 0, upP: 0, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		})
		obsUnbound.Bindings = nil
		src3 := &fakeSrc{obs: obsUnbound}
		m3, s3 := start(t, src3, clk3, usagestore.Options{})
		src3.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 0, upP: 0, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m3.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		m3.ResumeSampling()
		clk3.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src3.set(observe("boot-q3", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 2048, upP: 2, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m3.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ev3 := decodeStoredEvent(t, s3, 1)
		if ev3.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || len(ev3.Records) != 1 || ev3.Records[0].MemberId != memA || uint64(ev3.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 2048 {
			t.Fatalf("expected clean attribution after unbound baseline + CheckpointForRestart, got %+v", ev3)
		}
	})
}

// TestR33_Q4_PrecedenceAndClosedEpochs proves that closed-epoch handling
// (head.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil), boot-ID changes (power_loss), and counter resets
// (counter_discontinuity) take precedence over the now <= head.LastSample
// unchanged-checkpoint branch.
func TestR33_Q4_PrecedenceAndClosedEpochs(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 15, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	t.Run("no_open_epoch_precedes_rollback_branch", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q4", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})

		// Close the initial baseline epoch with FinalSample at t0.
		if err := m.FinalSample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		m.ResumeSampling()

		// Now OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil and LastSample == t0. Roll clock back 5s:
		// FinalSample returns ErrNoEpoch, while CheckpointForRestart runs
		// planBaseline and opens a new epoch with OpenReason == "after_final_sample"
		// and SampledAt == t0 (preserving LastSample without moving it backward).
		clk.Set(t0.Add(-5 * time.Second))
		if err := m.FinalSample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrNoEpoch) {
			t.Fatalf("FinalSample on closed epoch at rollback: got %v, want ErrNoEpoch", err)
		}
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart on closed epoch at rollback: %v", err)
		}
		h, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		if h.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || h.OpenReason != "after_final_sample" || !h.LastSample.Equal(t0) {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart on closed epoch did not open after_final_sample baseline: %+v", h)
		}
	})

	t.Run("boot_id_change_with_equal_counters_at_rollback_switches_epoch", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-1", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-1", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 4096, upP: 4, dnB: 8192, dnP: 8,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		h0, _ := s.Head(t.Context())

		// BootID changes to "boot-2" while counter values are identical and clock
		// is rolled back by 4s. Must NOT take the unchanged-checkpoint shortcut.
		clk.Set(t0.Add(6 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-2", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 4096, upP: 4, dnB: 8192, dnP: 8,
		}))
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart across BootID change: %v", err)
		}
		h1, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		if h1.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || h1.OpenEpoch == h0.OpenEpoch || h1.BootID != "boot-2" || h1.OpenReason != string(api.UsageGapReasonPowerLoss) || h1.NextSeq != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("BootID change did not switch epoch: %+v", h1)
		}
		ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 2)
		if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityGap || ev.Gap == nil || ev.Gap.Reason != api.UsageGapReasonPowerLoss || len(ev.Records) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("BootID change event: %+v, want power_loss gap with 0 records", ev)
		}
	})

	t.Run("counter_reset_at_rollback_preserves_other_device_delta_and_final_sample_closes", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, isFinal := range []bool{false, true} {
			clk := &clock{t: t0}
			src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q4",
				reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1},
				reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2},
			)}
			m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
			clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
			src.set(observe("boot-q4",
				reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 4096, upP: 4, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
				reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 2048, upP: 2, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
			))
			if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			h0, _ := s.Head(t.Context())

			// At 3s rollback (t0+7s), devA resets (4096 -> 512) while devB advances (2048 -> 3072).
			clk.Set(t0.Add(7 * time.Second))
			src.set(observe("boot-q4",
				reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 512, upP: 1, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
				reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 3072, upP: 3, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
			))
			var err error
			if isFinal {
				err = m.FinalSample(t.Context())
			} else {
				err = m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context())
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v on reset at rollback: %v", isFinal, err)
			}
			h1, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
			if h1.NextSeq != 3 {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v NextSeq=%d, want 3", isFinal, h1.NextSeq)
			}
			ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 2)
			if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityGap || ev.Gap == nil || ev.Gap.Reason != api.UsageGapReasonCounterDiscontinuity {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v event: %+v, want counter_discontinuity gap", isFinal, ev)
			}
			// Non-reset device devB's +1024 delta must be preserved in the gap event.
			if len(ev.Records) != 1 || ev.Records[0].DeviceId != devB || uint64(ev.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 1024 {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v gap records=%+v, want preserved +1024 for devB", isFinal, ev.Records)
			}
			if isFinal {
				if h1.OpenEpoch != uuid.Nil || h1.LastCloseReason != "final_sample" {
					t.Fatalf("FinalSample after reset switch left OpenEpoch=%s LastCloseReason=%q", h1.OpenEpoch, h1.LastCloseReason)
				}
			} else {
				if h1.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || h1.OpenEpoch == h0.OpenEpoch || h1.OpenReason != string(api.UsageGapReasonCounterDiscontinuity) {
					t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart after reset switch: %+v", h1)
				}
			}
		}
	})
}

// TestR33_Q5_ErrorsHealthAndBarriers proves that source-read failures, store
// failures, step-hook errors, and context cancellation fail closed during
// CheckpointForRestart, that ErrHold does NOT clear sourceFailed or
// persistFailed or advance lastMono, and that a successful CheckpointForRestart
// clears recovered failures and refreshes health.
func TestR33_Q5_ErrorsHealthAndBarriers(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 16, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	clk := &clock{t: t0}
	src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q5", reading{
		dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
	})}

	var hookErr error
	var failStep string
	dbPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "usage.db")
	s, err := usagestore.Open(dbPath, nodeID, incID, usagestore.Options{
		Now: clk.Now,
		Hook: func(step string) error {
			if hookErr != nil && step == failStep {
				return hookErr
			}
			return nil
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = s.Close() })
	m, err := New(Config{
		NodeID:        nodeID,
		IncarnationID: incID,
		Store:         s,
		Source:        src,
		Interval:      10 * time.Second,
		Now:           clk.Now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(m.Close)
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || !st.ForwardingAllowed {
		t.Fatalf("initial health: %+v err=%v", st, err)
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	mono0 := m.lastMono
	m.mu.Unlock()

	// 1. Source Read error during CheckpointForRestart latches ReasonMeterPath.
	clk.Set(t0.Add(time.Second))
	src.mu.Lock()
	src.err = errors.New("nft read failed")
	src.mu.Unlock()
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected error from failing Source.Read")
	}
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || st.ForwardingAllowed || st.Reason != ReasonMeterPath {
		t.Fatalf("health after Source.Read error: %+v err=%v, want ReasonMeterPath", st, err)
	}

	// 2. Restore Source.Read, but with changed readings at now == t0 so
	// CheckpointForRestart returns ErrHold. ErrHold returns before persist(),
	// clearSource(), and markSampled(), so ReasonMeterPath must remain latched
	// and lastMono must not advance!
	clk.Set(t0)
	src.set(observe("boot-q5", reading{
		dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 1000, upP: 1, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
	}))
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrHold, got %v", err)
	}
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || st.ForwardingAllowed || st.Reason != ReasonMeterPath {
		t.Fatalf("ErrHold cleared ReasonMeterPath: %+v err=%v", st, err)
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	monoAfterHold := m.lastMono
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if !monoAfterHold.Equal(mono0) {
		t.Fatalf("ErrHold advanced lastMono: got %s, want %s", monoAfterHold, mono0)
	}

	// 3. Restore unchanged readings at now == t0: CheckpointForRestart succeeds
	// and clears ReasonMeterPath.
	src.set(observe("boot-q5", reading{
		dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
	}))
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart recovery: %v", err)
	}
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || !st.ForwardingAllowed {
		t.Fatalf("health after successful CheckpointForRestart: %+v err=%v", st, err)
	}

	// 4. Fault hooks (StepRead, StepPlan, StepCheckpoint, StepBeforeCommit) roll
	// back without mutating Head on an unchanged CheckpointForRestart.
	for _, step := range []string{
		StepRead,
		StepPlan,
		usagestore.StepCheckpoint,
		usagestore.StepBeforeCommit,
	} {
		hBefore, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		failStep = step
		hookErr = errors.New("injected pre-commit fault")
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected error at step %s", step)
		}
		hookErr = nil
		hAfter, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(hAfter, hBefore) {
			t.Fatalf("%s fault mutated head: %+v vs %+v", step, hAfter, hBefore)
		}
	}

	// 5. Real SQLite persistence failure during unchanged CheckpointForRestart
	// latches ReasonPersistFail, ErrHold does NOT clear ReasonPersistFail, and
	// a subsequent successful CheckpointForRestart clears ReasonPersistFail.
	rawDB, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file:"+dbPath+"?_pragma=busy_timeout(5000)")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = rawDB.Close() })
	if _, err := rawDB.ExecContext(t.Context(),
		`CREATE TRIGGER r33_fail_counters BEFORE INSERT ON counters BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'simulated sqlite write failure'); END;`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected SQLite trigger failure during CheckpointForRestart")
	}
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || st.ForwardingAllowed || st.Reason != usagestore.ReasonPersistFail || !st.PersistFailed {
		t.Fatalf("health after SQLite failure: %+v err=%v, want ReasonPersistFail", st, err)
	}

	// Trigger ErrHold while persistFailed is latched: must stay ReasonPersistFail.
	src.set(observe("boot-q5", reading{
		dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 1000, upP: 1, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
	}))
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrHold) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrHold after SQLite failure, got %v", err)
	}
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || st.ForwardingAllowed || st.Reason != usagestore.ReasonPersistFail || !st.PersistFailed {
		t.Fatalf("ErrHold cleared ReasonPersistFail: %+v err=%v", st, err)
	}

	// Drop the trigger and restore unchanged readings: successful
	// CheckpointForRestart commits to SQLite and clears ReasonPersistFail.
	if _, err := rawDB.ExecContext(t.Context(), `DROP TRIGGER r33_fail_counters;`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	src.set(observe("boot-q5", reading{
		dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
	}))
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("recovery CheckpointForRestart after dropping trigger: %v", err)
	}
	if st, err := m.Health(t.Context()); err != nil || !st.ForwardingAllowed || st.PersistFailed {
		t.Fatalf("health did not recover after dropping trigger: %+v err=%v", st, err)
	}

	// 6. Cancelled context returns context.Canceled without corrupting Head.
	hBeforeCancel, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
	cctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	cancel()
	if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(cctx); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart with cancelled ctx: got %v, want context.Canceled", err)
	}
	hAfterCancel, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(hAfterCancel, hBeforeCancel) {
		t.Fatalf("cancelled CheckpointForRestart mutated head: %+v vs %+v", hAfterCancel, hBeforeCancel)
	}
}

// TestR33_Q6_ConcurrentCallersAndBarrierSemantics proves the deterministic
// concurrency and barrier invariants of CheckpointForRestart and FinalSample:
//   - When an in-flight Sample is blocked in Source.Read, CheckpointForRestart
//     (or FinalSample) waits in Barrier; once the Sample commits at timestamp T,
//     CheckpointForRestart runs at the same timestamp T == head.LastSample and
//     succeeds when readings are unchanged at that read (recording the +2000 B
//     delta from the in-flight Sample exactly once).
//   - While CheckpointForRestart is in flight, concurrent Sample calls return
//     ErrBusy without stealing m.inFinal or corrupting the checkpoint.
//   - After CheckpointForRestart returns, m.inFinal is false
//     and m.paused remains true (Sample returns ErrPaused) until ResumeSampling.
//   - After Close, all methods return ErrClosed.
func TestR33_Q6_ConcurrentCallersAndBarrierSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 17, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	t.Run("checkpoint_waits_for_in_flight_sample_then_succeeds_at_same_timestamp", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, isFinal := range []bool{false, true} {
			clk := &clock{t: t0}
			src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q6", reading{
				dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
			})}
			m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})

			// Prepare an in-flight Sample at t0+10s that blocks inside src.Read.
			clk.Set(t0.Add(10 * time.Second))
			hit := make(chan struct{}, 1)
			block := make(chan struct{})
			src.mu.Lock()
			src.obs = observe("boot-q6", reading{
				dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 2000, upP: 3, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
			})
			src.hit = hit
			src.block = block
			src.mu.Unlock()

			sampleDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				sampleDone <- m.Sample(t.Context())
			}()
			<-hit // in-flight Sample is now inside src.Read holding m.sampling = true

			// While the first Sample is in flight and before Barrier sets m.paused,
			// another Sample call returns ErrBusy.
			if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrBusy) {
				t.Fatalf("concurrent Sample while sampling in flight: got %v, want ErrBusy", err)
			}

			// Start CheckpointForRestart / FinalSample concurrently: it must set
			// m.paused = true and wait in Barrier for the in-flight Sample.
			barrierDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				if isFinal {
					barrierDone <- m.FinalSample(t.Context())
				} else {
					barrierDone <- m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context())
				}
			}()

			// Wait until m.paused is observed true (deterministic condition under m.mu).
			waitPaused(t, m)

			// Once Barrier sets m.paused = true (while waiting in Barrier before
			// setting m.inFinal = true), a concurrent Sample call returns ErrPaused.
			if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrPaused) {
				t.Fatalf("concurrent Sample while Barrier waiting: got %v, want ErrPaused", err)
			}

			// Clear src.block before releasing so the waiting CheckpointForRestart /
			// FinalSample does not block on src.Read after the first Sample finishes.
			src.mu.Lock()
			src.block = nil
			src.hit = nil
			src.mu.Unlock()
			close(block)

			if err := <-sampleDone; err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("in-flight Sample: %v", err)
			}
			if err := <-barrierDone; err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v after in-flight Sample at same timestamp: got %v, want nil", isFinal, err)
			}

			// Verify m.inFinal is cleared and m.paused remains true.
			m.mu.Lock()
			inFinalAfter := m.inFinal
			pausedAfter := m.paused
			m.mu.Unlock()
			if inFinalAfter || !pausedAfter {
				t.Fatalf("post-barrier flags: inFinal=%v paused=%v, want false/true", inFinalAfter, pausedAfter)
			}
			if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrPaused) {
				t.Fatalf("Sample while paused: got %v, want ErrPaused", err)
			}

			// Verify the in-flight Sample's +2000 delta was recorded exactly once.
			h, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
			if h.NextSeq != 2 || !h.LastSample.Equal(t0.Add(10*time.Second)) {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v head after barrier: %+v", isFinal, h)
			}
			ev := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 1)
			if ev.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || len(ev.Records) != 1 || uint64(ev.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 2000 {
				t.Fatalf("isFinal=%v event 1: %+v", isFinal, ev)
			}

			// After ResumeSampling, ordinary Sample works again.
			if !isFinal {
				m.ResumeSampling()
				clk.Set(t0.Add(20 * time.Second))
				if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("Sample after ResumeSampling: %v", err)
				}
			}
		}
	})

	t.Run("sample_called_while_checkpoint_in_flight_returns_errbusy_and_does_not_steal_restart", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: t0}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q6", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})
		h0, _ := s.Head(t.Context())

		// Block CheckpointForRestart inside src.Read at equal timestamp t0.
		hit := make(chan struct{}, 1)
		block := make(chan struct{})
		src.mu.Lock()
		src.hit = hit
		src.block = block
		src.mu.Unlock()

		ckptDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() {
			ckptDone <- m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context())
		}()
		<-hit // CheckpointForRestart is now inside src.Read with m.sampling=true, m.inFinal=true

		// A concurrent Sample call must return ErrBusy and leave m.inFinal intact.
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrBusy) {
			t.Fatalf("Sample during in-flight CheckpointForRestart: got %v, want ErrBusy", err)
		}
		close(block)
		if err := <-ckptDone; err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart completion: %v", err)
		}
		h1, _ := s.Head(t.Context())
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(h1, h0) {
			t.Fatalf("head changed unexpectedly: %+v vs %+v", h1, h0)
		}

		// Close makes all methods return ErrClosed.
		m.Close()
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) {
			t.Fatalf("Sample after Close: %v", err)
		}
		if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) {
			t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart after Close: %v", err)
		}
		if err := m.FinalSample(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) {
			t.Fatalf("FinalSample after Close: %v", err)
		}
	})
}

// TestR33_Q7_PeriodsAndMonthBoundary proves that an unchanged
// CheckpointForRestart at or rolled back across a UTC month boundary
// (2026-11-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-10-31T23:59:55Z / 23:59:50Z) preserves
// head.LastSample at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, so the next forward sample in
// November has PeriodId == "2026-11" and Quality == complete (neither
// boundary_estimated nor "2026-10"), while missed boundaries and >interval
// rollbacks obey §10.2 and §10.9.
func TestR33_Q7_PeriodsAndMonthBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	octEnd := time.Date(2026, 10, 31, 23, 59, 50, 0, time.UTC)
	novStart := time.Date(2026, 11, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	t.Run("unchanged_checkpoint_at_or_rolled_back_into_prior_month_preserves_november_start", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: octEnd}
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q7", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})

		// Sample right at the exact UTC month boundary 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.
		// Because head.LastSample was 2026-10-31T23:59:50Z and IntervalEnd is
		// stamped on 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, usagestore.PeriodID(head.LastSample)
		// assigns [23:59:50Z, 00:00:00Z) to "2026-10" with Quality == complete.
		clk.Set(novStart)
		src.set(observe("boot-q7", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 1000, upP: 2, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		evOct := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 1)
		if evOct.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || len(evOct.Records) != 1 || evOct.Records[0].PeriodId != "2026-10" {
			t.Fatalf("boundary sample 1: Quality=%s Records=%+v, want complete in 2026-10", evOct.Quality, evOct.Records)
		}

		// Run CheckpointForRestart with unchanged readings at:
		//   1) exact boundary 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z
		//   2) 5s rollback into October (2026-10-31T23:59:55Z)
		//   3) exact 10s interval rollback into October (2026-10-31T23:59:50Z)
		for _, now := range []time.Time{
			novStart,
			novStart.Add(-5 * time.Second),
			novStart.Add(-10 * time.Second),
		} {
			clk.Set(now)
			if err := m.CheckpointForRestart(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart at %s: %v", now, err)
			}
			h, err := s.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !h.LastSample.Equal(novStart) || h.NextSeq != 2 {
				t.Fatalf("CheckpointForRestart at %s moved LastSample=%s or NextSeq=%d, want %s and 2",
					now, h.LastSample, h.NextSeq, novStart)
			}
		}

		// Resume sampling and advance into November (2026-11-01T00:00:10Z) with +3000 bytes.
		m.ResumeSampling()
		clk.Set(novStart.Add(10 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q7", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 4000, upP: 5, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		evNov := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 2)
		if evNov.Quality != api.UsageQualityComplete || len(evNov.Records) != 1 || evNov.Records[0].PeriodId != "2026-11" {
			t.Fatalf("November sample 2: Quality=%s Records=%+v, want complete in 2026-11", evNov.Quality, evNov.Records)
		}
		if !evNov.IntervalStart.Equal(novStart) || !evNov.IntervalEnd.Equal(novStart.Add(10*time.Second)) {
			t.Fatalf("November sample 2 interval=[%s, %s), want [%s, %s)",
				evNov.IntervalStart, evNov.IntervalEnd, novStart, novStart.Add(10*time.Second))
		}
		if uint64(evNov.Records[0].UploadBytes) != 3000 {
			t.Fatalf("November sample 2 records=%+v, want +3000 bytes", evNov.Records)
		}
	})

	t.Run("missed_boundary_marks_boundary_estimated_and_gap_takes_precedence", func(t *testing.T) {
		clk := &clock{t: octEnd.Add(5 * time.Second)} // 2026-10-31T23:59:55Z
		src := &fakeSrc{obs: observe("boot-q7", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1,
		})}
		m, s := start(t, src, clk, usagestore.Options{})

		// Forward sample spanning [23:59:55Z, 00:00:15Z) across the month boundary
		// where now.Sub(boundary) > interval (missed boundary sample) must be
		// marked boundary_estimated with PeriodId == "2026-10" (usagestore.PeriodID
		// attributes to head.LastSample's UTC month while flagging boundary_estimated
		// for central projection).
		clk.Set(novStart.Add(15 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q7", reading{
			dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 1500, upP: 2, dnB: 0, dnP: 0,
		}))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		evEst := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 1)
		if evEst.Quality != api.UsageQualityBoundaryEstimated || len(evEst.Records) != 1 || evEst.Records[0].PeriodId != "2026-10" {
			t.Fatalf("missed-boundary sample: Quality=%s Records=%+v, want boundary_estimated in 2026-10", evEst.Quality, evEst.Records)
		}

		// A gap spanning a month boundary (e.g. counter reset from 2026-11-30T23:59:55Z
		// to 2026-12-01T00:00:15Z with positive delta on devB) keeps Quality == gap
		// (gap takes precedence over boundary_estimated per §10.2).
		decBoundary := time.Date(2026, 12, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
		clk.Set(decBoundary.Add(-5 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q7",
			reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 1500, upP: 2, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
			reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 1000, upP: 1, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
		))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		clk.Set(decBoundary.Add(15 * time.Second))
		src.set(observe("boot-q7",
			reading{dev: devA, mem: memA, rev: 1, upB: 100, upP: 1, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
			reading{dev: devB, mem: memB, rev: 2, upB: 1500, upP: 2, dnB: 0, dnP: 0},
		))
		if err := m.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		evGap := decodeStoredEvent(t, s, 3)
		if evGap.Quality != api.UsageQualityGap || evGap.Gap == nil || evGap.Gap.Reason != api.UsageGapReasonCounterDiscontinuity || len(evGap.Records) != 1 || evGap.Records[0].PeriodId != "2026-11" {
			t.Fatalf("cross-boundary reset event: Quality=%s Gap=%+v Records=%+v, want gap/counter_discontinuity in 2026-11",
				evGap.Quality, evGap.Gap, evGap.Records)
		}
	})
}

func decodeStoredEvent(t *testing.T, s *usagestore.Store, seq uint64) api.UsageEvent {
	t.Helper()
	se, err := s.Event(t.Context(), seq)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Event(%d): %v", seq, err)
	}
	var ev api.UsageEvent
	if err := json.Unmarshal(se.Payload, &ev); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal Event(%d): %v", seq, err)
	}
	return ev
}

func waitPaused(t *testing.T, m *Meter) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		m.mu.Lock()
		paused := m.paused
		m.mu.Unlock()
		if paused {
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatal("timed out waiting for m.paused == true")
}
